notes.title: Super Squash 4.1 - HUD Overhaul
notes.content:
[b](4.1.02 & 4.1.01 have been added to the update log)[/b]
[h2]Super Squash 4.1 has just dropped![/h2]
This update mostly includes several things that didn't quite make in time for 4.0. Let's get into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/fc17f834a964a5da5673bd0f2794003c9c6e112a.png[/img]


[h2]HUD Overhaul:[/h2]
One thing I've wanted to address for years now was the HUD which restricted itself to a 1920x1080 resolution. Fortunately that's no longer the case! All of the important elements will display right above your character. [b](They will only appear when certain stats change. For an example, picking up a coin or losing health.)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/3ac7389a6209e38ee428181a3097f5231911ede5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/39d12ecf7b241c69c5454145c5b941f0afbb684f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/e16e47634106a2027f38a50393a1d853d3aa82a3.png[/img]

With this change several features have been implemented. Whenever the player's ultimate is ready, a notification will display on-screen and your character will flash yellow until you use it. The player will also flash red when low on health (even if you have your ultimate ready).



[h2]Barlock Games has a new logo![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/1d58ede97632136d2dffe0faf50bcc131321600c.png[/img]

While it's definitely not an important addition, this new logo has replaced the older one when launching the game.


[h2]Update Log:[/h2]

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] NEW Overhauled HUD UI (ALL of the HUD elements will now display above the player, meaning MOST resolutions should be supported with Super Squash now!)
[*] New character indications (The player will either flash yellow when their ultimate is ready or red when they're low on health.)
[*] New Barlock Games logo when launching the game
[/list]

[h3]Fixes: (4.1.01)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the destructible structures from flashing red even when destroyed (Hell Wars world)
[*] Fixed the player from not continuously flashing when either their ultimate is ready or health is low
[*] Fixed some of the new HUD positioning (some elements would overlap the player)
[/list]

[h3]Changes: (4.1.02)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed specific HUD positioning (several elements were overlapping each other)
[/list]

[h3]Until next time![/h3]

notes.title: Super Squash 4.0 + F2P NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[h2]Surprise! Super Squash 4.0 has just dropped![/h2]
Let's discuss what this update includes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/e53b1c46385607ef4c91451cd7169bbda47a7871.png[/img]

[h2]Visual Enhancements:[/h2]
Upon re-visiting Super Squash, I noticed there were a lot of areas that seemed quite empty or stale. With this update I tried adding more variety whether it's extra details on the floors and walls or in some cases entirely new lighting; Super Squash has a new yet familiar style that'll hopefully be more pleasing to look at. [b]Let's take a look at some examples:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/a0312ba80002e88374de6944b477ca644fe6c85a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/923b10c81e675a9b0ff96a3cfb3383dc2c490ef8.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/e25dd486267f19200542329182f147638aa12138.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/96eed56f957f824483bd313800bef63048490dc9.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/1bf5220080beb3f2c0b7d87d5096397420144a3e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/340d8e5f0bb216f496484352a58a1c3ab425a808.png[/img]
There are plenty of more changes throughout the designs though I felt like these were the most substantial differences.



[h2]Squash Mode:[/h2]
Squash Mode is a challenging yet fun new take within Super Squash's already existing foundation. You start off as a random character and must complete 5 levels. All of which are also randomly selected. Upon each level completion, you'll be given a set of new challenges for the next level. [b]Here are some examples: [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/1a6bbf80555a5a7e0348747becb8a5da432094b6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/7ebd15475935f8637e9c9ca9243e0ad25fae1d9e.png[/img]

I won't spoil all of the challenges following the later levels but I wholeheartedly believe this is an incredible addition to Super Squash. I've also added an achievement upon successfully completing the mode!



[h2]Squash Museum:[/h2]
[b]This mode is exclusive to owners who paid for the game before it's free to play transition.[/b] Squash Museum is an insight on many cut areas and content that never found a place in the game along with some fun trivia! [b]Here's a little glimpse of it:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/5f39404dc340de245b273be4d8c8054f019c19db.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/f46c243b7d8c37b445c231563ffa5adca8a87f8d.png[/img]



[h2]LOTS of Improvements:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/fcc41d7ad33b7b713ecf1546918a3224a31e6dbb.png[/img]
When play-testing Super Squash, my original intentions of re-visiting this game was to address the many bugs and issues that's surrounded the game for years now- and that's exactly what I've done. While there are some minor changes to be made, a majority of the game should feel pretty fluid. [b]Let's go over the update notes:[/b]



[h2]Update Log:[/h2]

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added Squash Mode (5 random levels and randomly selected characters. Each level progressively spawns specific enemy types and alters gameplay elements such as disabling lives, random traps, enraged enemies, lower HP, etc)
[*]Added Squash Museum [b](FOR PAID PLAYERS)[/b] (Jump into never before seen areas and maps which didn't make the final cut of Super Squash)
[*]Added 3 Achievements
[*]Added various details throughout the game (extra background objects, extra colored walls/floors/objects so areas feel different from each other)
[*]Added progression arrows throughout the game (this will help with less instructive areas)
[*]Added footstep sounds (these are disabled by default but can be toggled in the settings)
[*]Added a red glow effect to mission specific objects throughout the game (this will indicate said objects need to be destroyed)
[*]Added new background of main menu
[*]Added fading transitions to the main menu
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed the ending cutscene from resulting in a black screen after completion
of first level (Terror World)
[*]Fixed an error from occurring when loading the third level of Terror World (through both menu's and cutscene)
[*]Fixed being able to hear footsteps in the distance when loading the third level of Terror World (this also applies to quitting to the menu when on the same level)
[*]Fixed the exit door from being deleted when locating all keys within the third level of Terror World
[*]Fixed the level from changing the character to Butch when acquiring both throwing knives while on Blitz Mode (Hell Wars World)
[*]Fixed Daiku World from soft-locking upon level completion (Both Free and Blitz modes)
[*]Fixed the game from crashing when defeating the final boss (Daiku World)
[*]Fixed the enemy spawn-rate of Hellentusks' second phase (Hectic Trouble World)
[*]Fixed Nightmare Axe from dropping a white cube when being defeated (Hectic Trouble World)
[*]Fixed cutscenes from playing while on Blitz Mode (Hell Wars, Hectic Trouble and Daiku Worlds)
[*]Fixed fire effect from remaining once it's corresponding torch was destroyed (Hell Wars & Daiku Worlds)
[*]Fixed Hectic Trouble & Daiku Worlds from initiating boss fights off-screen when loading specific levels
[*]Fixed the Steel Tranquilizer enemies from permanently slowing the player down when attacked by them
[*]Fixed Lava and Kor enemies from not dropping coins or progressing objective
counters when defeated
[*]Fixed various fire effects from not emitting in darker areas
[*]Fixed Kor Nests from des-pawning when in Blitz mode
[*]Fixed Klank's firing effect (it is now no longer green)
[*]Fixed explosion death of Lava enemies (they are now the appropriate color)
[*]Fixed certain HUD elements from staying on-screen when quitting to the main menu
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed Blitz mode's random probabilities (levels across the entire game can now be a starting point rather than the first level of each world)
[*]Changed Blitz mode's level completion (upon completing a level you'll immediately be taken to another random level with a random character)
[*]Changed the HP of Wizard boss in Terror World (lowered by 50%)
[*]Changed Dwenguil's model (it has been replaced with Malfunction II's)
[*]Changed the scale and HP of specific enemies (this is so it's more distinctive which class they are)
[*]Changed fire-rate of specific characters (Klank, LanternMan and Ashira all fire 50% faster. Mairoid's fire-rate was decreased)
[*]Changed the destruction of torches. They should ALL now have the option to be destroyed
[*]Changed both icon and loading screen
[/list]

[b]Enjoy the update and until next time, stay tuned for future updates![/b]

notes.title: Super Squash - 3.2
notes.content:
[b]What's this? Another Super Squash update?! Yup! However this update mostly addresses several issues I've had on my backlog for a long while.[/b]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed levels from not resetting when replaying them via Story Mode
[*]Fixed Nightmare Axe from dropping a white sprite after defeated
[*]Fixed Nightmare Axe from dropping the key in a different area after defeated
[/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed the Steam library image of Super Squash
[/list]

[b]That's all I've got for now! If you manage to run into anything be sure to let me know in the forums. Until next time![/b]

notes.content:
[h3]Here's a short quick update regarding several issues within the game.[/h3]

[h2]Super Squash 3.1:[/h2]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed the "All Set!" achievement from not unlocking (apologies!)
[*]Fixed the game from potentially crashing when attempting to left-click on the intro after exiting to the menu
[*]Fixed the final boss from still being able to attack when defeated (Daiku World)

[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]The key to progress will now be re-located within the next area after defeating Nightmare Axe (Hectic Trouble World)
[/list]

notes.title: Super Squash 2.0 Available NOW
notes.content:
[h1]Super Squash 2.0 is available RIGHT NOW![/h1]

[b]Let's discuss what this update introduces![/b]


[h2]NEW characters: Ashira and Luthyuis[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/95eba9744a4e75dbdd5b912bdd2ad22dc4915011.png[/img]
[b]These characters blast their way into the massive roster of Super Squash! Featuring unique appearances and abilities.[/b]


[h2]NEW world: Daiku[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/5fa6cbdb351614bd897529c3fe9b92f419186109.png[/img]
[b]What was once a very habitable and happy place of life is now a deadly wasteland full of aliens. There will be PLENTY of enemies and objects that stand within your path. Do what you do best and squash them all![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/a7d4dba5fbeb8e9ae241fbdb4b3ef9a20f3b8069.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/df2ed7fa168303a24cf9bcb77f2166ee4a942084.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/63a1ff9a51c39899277e552e3090bdfedf3bca0a.png[/img]


[h2]NEW overhauled menu[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/38e427033940367d13c612c00686458a6da9f266.png[/img]
[b]These new menu's will simply take you from point A to point B without causing confusion.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/0d299e30fc2a158c9269afffb6248fb2b579eb50.png[/img]
[b]Hidden trophies have also been added to every level of Super Squash! Good luck on finding them![/b]


[h2]FULL Update Notes:[/h2]

Additions:
[list]
[*]Added an OVERHAULED menu (It is now much more easier to navigate and understand)
[*]Added 1 NEW world! (This world contains a brand new environment as well as addition to the Super Squash story)
[*]Added 5 NEW enemies!
[*]Added 2 NEW playable characters!
[*]Added 5 NEW achievements
[*]Added collectible trophies throughout the entire game (You can find one trophy per level)
[*]Added fog throughout Hell Wars World
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed the key from being invisble after defeating Nightmare Axe (Hectic Trouble World)
[/list]


[b]I hope you all enjoy the latest content update for Super Squash! Blast through those new enemies and have fun collecting all of the hidden trophies! Stay tuned for future updates.[/b]
